versions.content: A SdClientService shall only connect to one offered service in- stance of the same service at the same time. When a client is already connected to a service instance it shall ignore all Offer Service entries for the same service instance with different endpoint as long as the already connected service instance is considered available and report SEV_DUPLICATE_OFFER.
